subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should this draft be allowed to proceed only after canonical sender normalization and after-fix live proof, or should maintainers accept the current source-only identity risk?
rationale: The repaired sender becomes the identity used for iMessage authorization, pairing, routing, and replies, so source-only confidence is not enough without maintainer intent or real after-fix evidence.

options.title: Require Normalized Repair And Proof
options.body: Block merge until peer selection uses canonical iMessage handle normalization and redacted after-fix evidence shows the peer sender and reply or pairing target are correct.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Identity Risk
options.body: Maintainers can merge the current branch based on source review and pre-fix incident evidence while owning the remaining identity-boundary uncertainty.

options.title: Pause For Narrower Root Cause
options.body: If the author's current failure is different, pause or close this draft and track the remaining iMessage root cause separately.

recommendation.title: Require Normalized Repair And Proof
recommendation.body: Block merge until peer selection uses canonical iMessage handle normalization and redacted after-fix evidence shows the peer sender and reply or pairing target are correct.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the nearby anchorless iMessage repair and already asked for the proof needed to land this branch safely.
